messages.subject: R765 host-copy source research complete
messages.body: I reviewed official Intel LLVM/Unified Runtime v2 sources and measurement documentation, then wrote the bounded findings to the named report. The pinned v7.1.1 source shows a nonblocking append path but a batched-queue back-pressure drain can still host-synchronize; source does not establish installed binary provenance, queue mode, or B570 performance. The report proposes a falsifiable ordinary-host versus malloc_host comparison that separates call CPU, wait, and full-copy time; no build, test, or GPU run was performed.
